title: One-Roll Malevolent Cult — What Problems Does It Have

entries.value: The leadership is insane in unhelpful ways
It has caught the eye of a dangerous enemy
One of its bound creatures or servants is out of control
It is running low on sacrifices and new recruits
It has been impoverished by a recent trouble
There is a dangerous schism in its ranks
Its god is making unreasonable and escalating demands
The lay believers are demanding much from the priests
The cult's enforcers are muscling the clerical leadership
The god's influence has become distant and unreliable
An important member has turned traitor
Another dark faith is actively at war with it
